title: Table owner bypasses Row-Level Security
what: A table's owner is also exempt unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is set. relforcerowsecurity defaults to false.
why_invisible: Same silence as the superuser case, different cause. Migrations and ops queries running as the owner see everything.
detection: ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on every table carrying a policy.
evidence: Confirmed while building the RLS harness: running the probe as the table owner returned recall 0.95 with no restriction applied, because the owner is exempt.
